title: Transactional qualification for AC1024 associative geometry and value dependency output

source.fixturePolicy: Existing local sample only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added to Git.

implementation.change: After the geometry-dependency and value-dependency output finalizers pass, stage each proof row's exact source handle in the per-write opaque identity qualification set. The set is still published only after the DXF transaction commits. Require an attempted DWG read before applying the opaque callback gate, so locally authored dx_data marked DWG is not mistaken for an import with a missing callback census.
proofRoutes: 54 ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY identities: typed source profile, emitted identity, owner/target role closure and fresh output decoding through finalizeDxfAssociativeGeometryOutput.
30 ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY identities: typed dependency/value profile, emitted dependency/owner/target/peer identities and fresh output decoding through finalizeDxfAssociativeValueOutput.
implementation.failureBehavior: Strict refusal remains pre-publication; staged identities from a failed attempt are discarded. The opaque callback check remains fail-closed for actual DWG reads.

strictAttempt.diagnostic: strict-complete conversion requires output qualification for every opaque DWG callback (qualified=155/228)

validation.fullSuites: NOT_RUN; focused adapter tests and a same-source strict/legacy export probe were used.

limitations: 155/228 is a source-identity conversion qualification count, not semantic support evidence or strict-complete export success.
P4 remains open; the 73 unqualified callback identities continue to block strict export.
No LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, native-platform, ABI/package, or 3D semantic qualification is promoted.

nextPacket.operation: Connect the existing AC1024 VISUALSTYLE source/output/readback proof to the transactional opaque identity qualification set.
nextPacket.focusedSelector: libdxfrw_visual_style_ac1024_typed_writer plus the existing physical output/readback selector
nextPacket.condition: Stage source handles only after unchanged-source checks, record identity/owner closure, typed field comparison and fresh output decoding all pass.
